stop_decision.reason: Phase 2 Critic ran all 5 existing traces (all 1.0/1.0), then escalated twice: escalation 1 (traces 06-07, 1.0/1.0) and escalation 2 (traces 08-09, 1.0/1.0). All 9 traces scored 1.0/1.0 after two difficulty escalations. Exit condition 1 satisfied: Critic cannot break it.

trace_registry.description: Medication add/dose-update/discontinue, allergy, basic profile. Tests dedup and discontinuation semantics.
Symptom episodes, wellness entries, care timeline with lab values. Tests health_log.jsonl keyword retrieval including natural-language date search.
Health goals and progress updates, follow-up appointments, symptom-medication cross-reference.
Implicit/passive health capture and synonym-based recall (medical terminology vs. lay language). Tests LLM extraction paraphrase vs keyword recall.
Multi-update collision (most recent weight wins), goal target revision, allergy-medication cross-reference.
Escalation 1: symptom resolution tracking, lab values with specific numbers, care timeline precision, follow-up date recall.
Escalation 1: multi-step medication dose escalation, date-specific wellness recall, A1C goal revision, lisinopril cough cross-reference.

Escalation 2: high-density supplement capture (vitamin D 3000 IU, magnesium 400mg, fish oil), shellfish allergy, medication discontinuation with reason, implicit symptom mentions in non-health context.
Escalation 2: goal completion recognition (weight goal hit), lab value trend across sessions (cholesterol improvement), exercise goal with progress.

weakness: Natural-language date recall fails in health_log.jsonl: timestamps stored in ISO format (2026-04-15) but users query by human-readable dates ('April 15', 'April 12'). Affects all date-anchored recall queries for symptom log (requirement 6) and recent care timeline (requirement 5). 4 of 6 trace_02 queries fail on this issue.
Minor: HEALTH.md Recent Care Timeline date attribution error (off by one day).

improvement: Added _add_human_date() in consolidation.py: every new health_log entry includes a 'date_human' field (e.g. 'April 15, 2026'), making new entries searchable by month-name queries.
Added _iso_from_natural_date() in memory/__init__.py recall(): converts 'April 15' queries to ISO prefix '2026-04-15' and searches both forms — backward-compatible with existing entries.
Propagated both fixes to nanobot/agent/memory.py: append_health_log() adds 'date_human'; search_health_log() applies ISO normalization.
weakness: LLM extraction paraphrase breaks keyword recall: user says 'swollen ankles', stored as 'ankle swelling'. 'swollen' not a substring of 'swelling'. Affects health_log.jsonl keyword grep path when LLM normalizes user vocabulary to medical terminology.

improvement: Updated prompts.py HEALTH_EXTRACT_SYSTEM: added instruction to preserve user's exact phrasing in health_log content fields with '[user: <exact words>]' annotation. Makes user vocabulary directly searchable.
Added _morph_root() and _morph_terms() helpers in memory/__init__.py: strips common English inflectional/derivational suffixes to generate search roots as additional search terms in recall().
Applied the same morphological root search in nanobot/agent/memory.py search_health_log().
